scope: Static accessibility correction contract for modal semantics, focus containment, labels, live feedback and minimum target sizing. Physical iPhone/Safari and real assistive-technology acceptance remain manual.

results.name: Auth overlay is promoted to a named modal dialog
Modal opening moves focus and blocks the background
Modal focus is trapped and restored
Auth fields receive programmatic labels and live feedback
Small guest and legal targets meet the 24 CSS pixel floor
Accessibility correction loads without editing the locked page
